title: Figures 73-74: Tic Tac CFD Mach number at 300 mph and pressure at 400 mph
description: Two color CFD contour plots of the capsule-shaped "Tic Tac" body at 1/6 scale with numeric color legends. Captions read "Figure 73. Tic Tac Mach Number at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 300 mph with Subsonic Inlet and Subsonic Outlet" and "Figure 74. Tic Tac Pressure at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 400 mph with Mixed Inlet and Subsonic Outlet," the latter showing a pressure peak at the nose in Pa. Attachment II, page 120 of the BAASS report.
